name: – Tomáš Kubín – Article 12, § 4 – Am 95
title: REPORT on the proposal for a Council directive on the structure and rates of excise duty applied to tobacco and tobacco related products (recast)
part_text: 4. From 1 January 2031 each Member State shall ensure that the overall excise duty on manufactured tobacco and tobacco related products respect the minimum tax levels specified in Article 16, Article 20(2) and Article 22(2) and adjusted in accordance with paragraphs 2, 3 and 3a of this Article from the first day of the year following the year in which the adjustment occurs.
